verdict.rationale: MotherDuck is a cloud data warehouse with built-in AI features (LLM functions, Dives, MCP), so whether customer data is used for model training is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack contains no policy, setting, or opt-out about AI training on customer data. SaaS Mode, user-scoped secrets, and read-only MCP access are adjacent security controls and earn no credit here.
